items.title: Jonathan Taylor: Sticking around in Indy
items.text:
The Colts informed Taylor that he won't be traded before Tuesday's deadline, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyler Murray: Managing Grade 2 hamstring strain
items.text:
Murray is considered week-to-week due to a Grade 2 hamstring strain and isn't expected to be available for Sunday's game against the Packers, James Palmer of Bleacher Report reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Fernando Mendoza: New No. 1 in Vegas after Cousins trade
items.text:
Mendoza will take over as the Raiders' new starting quarterback beginning with Sunday's game versus the Seahawks after Las Vegas traded Kirk Cousins to Minnesota on Tuesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kirk Cousins: Returning to Minnesota
items.text:
The Vikings acquired Cousins from the Raiders on Tuesday in exchange for a 2027 third-round pick, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Keenan Allen: Shipped to San Francisco
items.text:
The 49ers acquired Allen from the Colts on Tuesday in exchange for a 2027 sixth-round pick, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
